name: Мемори
tagline: Открывайте по две карты и найдите все пары.
description: Играйте в «Мемори» бесплатно: находите пары среди 12, 20 или 30 карт — одни на время, в онлайн-гонке или с друзьями и ботами.
about: Memory Match is the classic game of pairs. The cards lie face down, and every symbol is on exactly two of them. Turn two over: if they match, they stay up; if not, they turn back, and you try to remember where they were.

Play alone to clear the table in the fewest flips and the least time, or race friends online on the same layout. To play together on one device, pick 2 to 4 players and take turns, or play against bots that remember more of what they've seen at each difficulty.
There are 12, 20 or 30 cards, with 15 symbols drawn for kefche, each a different shape in a different colour.
howToPlay: Choose how many cards. Alone, the clock starts with the first layout.
Turn a card over, then another.
A matching pair stays face up. Two cards that don't match show for a moment and turn back.
Playing together, a player who finds a pair goes again; a miss passes the turn. The most pairs wins.
Alone, the game ends when every pair is found.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap a card to turn it.
Keyboard: move between cards with the arrow keys, and press Enter or Space to turn one.
Pause or start again from the bar above the game.
tips: Turn the first card of each go somewhere new, and the second where you think its pair is.
Work along the rows: a fixed order makes places easier to remember.
Say the symbols to yourself as they turn: words stick better than pictures.
Against others, watch their flips too: every card they show is one you know.
Late in the game few cards are left, so a careful second flip is often a sure pair.

faq.question: Is Memory Match free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: Can I play with friends?
faq.answer: Yes. Play together on one device with 2 to 4 players, or race friends online on the same layout. Taking turns online is coming later.

faq.question: How good are the bots?
faq.answer: Easy bots forget most of what they see, medium bots remember more, and hard bots remember nearly every card.

faq.question: How do races work?
faq.answer: Everyone in the room gets the same layout at the same moment, and the first to find every pair wins.
